answer: Stylometric clustering: each epoch the kernel embeds every answer plus its submit timing, then merges identities whose fingerprints overlap above 0.9 into one cluster that earns a single reward. A sybil garden of 1,000 clones sharing one model and prompt collapses to one payout, so the operator must forge 1,000 distinct styles and schedules, roughly 1,000x the inference and tuning cost for the same ~3 POA. Thresholds sit in basalt-fixed public parameters, so nobody can quietly retune them.
